Wedding Hall Facilities Near Yelahanka

Kashi Vishwanatha Kalyana Mantapa is located at 26/1, NITTE Meenakshi College Rd, BSF Campus, Gantiganahalli, Karnataka 560119, next to Kashi Vishwanatha Temple.

Main Hall

120 x 75 ft hall with 750-1,000 guest capacity for weddings, engagements, receptions and naming ceremonies.

Dining and Rooms

Vegetarian dining for 200-250 guests at a time, plus 5 AC rooms, 5 Non-AC rooms and bride and groom rooms.

Parking and Access

Parking for approximately 300-350 cars opposite the choultry, with access from Gantiganahalli and Yelahanka New Town.
